summary: Constructing Date from an arbitrary runtime String requires Date.parse including implementation-defined non-standard parsing behavior.

target.notes: A compatibility runtime must define which implementation-defined Date.parse extensions it emulates.

semantics.parsing: standard grammar first; otherwise implementation-defined permitted extensions

caveats: Non-standard parsing differs across JavaScript engines and versions.

tests.name: standard string still works through general path
non-standard spelling is implementation-defined
tests.expected_behavior: behavior must match the selected JavaScript compatibility runtime/host policy; static .NET parsing must not be assumed equivalent
